author: toketrain
body:
I was wondering what the deal with the monument scoreboard is? Because at first glance it looks like it starts out a certain color (I've only seen yellow) and turns another color (lime green) when broken.

This is nifty and all, but for people like me who have colorblindness, it's not so great. I can barely tell the colors apart unless I focus for a while (that's how I initially found out those colors).

The check/x symbols were great because I could glance really quick and see just based on shape. This is also a bit more ugly, just had to say.

Basically I was wondering if what I thought was the deal with the new scoreboard is correct.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
It's Capture The Wool

Red = The wool has not been grabbed yet
Yellow = Someone  took wool out of the chest before
Green = Someone placed the wool on their base
